verdict.rationale: Adyen explicitly documents offline payments continuing when internet drops (docs-8) and markets terminals that 'stay up and running, even when the internet is down' (docs-25), implying store-and-forward. However, no evidence details the specifics of storage limits, forwarding reconciliation behavior, or hands-on validation of this feature working reliably in practice, and one community comment reflects frustration with card-present integration complexity generally.
